Hi Emily + Jonathan,

Thanks again for the call earlier — really useful to understand CardioSense's latency SLAs and the regulatory envelope you operate in. This note pulls together the small set of next steps so we can lock a focused architecture workshop (60–75 minutes) with our ops and solutions teams.

Proposed objective for the workshop:
- Validate network topology and firewall requirements for the Private/VPC deployment
- Confirm data flow boundaries and KMS key management approach
- Walk through the runbook for upgrades, backups, and audit logging (SOC2-sensitive items)

Suggested agenda (45–60 min core + 15 min buffer):
1) 5m — Introductions & success criteria
2) 15m — CardioSense current infra & constraints (network, peering, proxies)
3) 20m — Redwood Private deployment architecture (placement, subnets, IPs)
4) 15m — Security/compliance calls-outs & pre-launch checklist
5) 10m — Action items / owners / next steps

Availability: can you pick one of these windows (we'll send a calendar invite once you confirm):
- Wed May 31, 10:00–11:15 PT
- Thu Jun 1, 13:00–14:15 PT
- Fri Jun 2, 08:30–09:45 PT

I'm copying our ops lead Rishi and solutions engineer Laura on the next message to lock a time and cover pre-call asks. Attaching a short prep checklist and a sample network template that you can review beforehand.

Thanks,
